# miniz

Vendored copy of [miniz](https://github.com/richgel999/miniz), a single-file
zlib-compatible compression and ZIP archive library.

- Version: 3.1.2 (see `miniz.c`)
- License: MIT (see `LICENSE`)

It provides the ZIP archive support used by the `.nts1mkii` workspace reader
and writer. Fedora packages can build against the system `miniz-devel`
package instead of this copy.
